Verse timestamps: Quranic Universal Audio, Wider Community, CC BY 4.0.
https://github.com/QUD-Technologies/quranic-universal-audio/releases/tag/v3.2.0
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
Derived from verse_timestamps.json.gz + catalog.json for four named editions.
Grouped by surah; lossless delta-ms encoding [ayah,start minus previous end,duration], with previous end initially zero. Repeated occurrences retained.
Audio streams from the exact original URLs in each edition catalog; recordings remain the property of reciters/upstream sources.
See reports/quran-continuous-sources.json in source archive for hashes and coverage.
Yasser/Qatami editions provide no 1:1 cue; none has been invented.
